title: run.skill.md Phase 3 retains patch_file preference contrary to deprecate-patch-file spec
description: Phase 3 of run.skill.md still instructs agents to prefer patch_file for changes fewer than ~20 lines, contradicting the moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path specification that mandates write_file as the unconditional default for all file modifications. This caused no-preferred-patch-file to fail in this run, reducing rubric_score.
proposed_resolution: Run a targeted spec to update Phase 3 of run.skill.md, making write_file the unconditional default for all file modifications and removing the patch_file preference branch entirely.
